args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production following deployment. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback was executed and verified (status: rolled_out, VERIFIED). Recommend root-causing v2.3.1 before re-deployment; v2.3.1 was never healthy in production and will require change-manager approval to re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Root cause:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks after the latest deploy. The release history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version healthy in production.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout status: `rolled_out`, verified.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** — "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0" — which paged the on-call engineer. The incident summary documents the rollback and notes that v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so re-deploying it will require change-manager approval.

**Follow-up for the team:** Root-cause v2.3.1 before attempting any re-deploy.
